metadata.framework: Extended STIRPAT (Dietz & Rosa 1997) + IPCC AR6 WG3 Chapter 2

equations.CO2_FF: Kaya identity + STIRPAT (Kaya 1990, Liddle 2015, IPCC AR6 WG3 Fig 2.16)
equations.CH4: AFOLU Kaya decomposition (Hong et al. 2021, IPCC AR6 WG3 Fig 2.21)
equations.N2O: Agricultural soil emissions (IPCC AR6 WG3 Table 2.1)
equations.CO2_AFOLU: Land use structural proxy (IPCC AR6 WG3 Section 2.4.2.5, Martin Drews recommendation)

notes.CO2_FF: Kaya identity specification. CO2 total used as proxy for fossil fuel CO2.
notes.CH4: AgriLand is a proxy for agricultural methane pathways (enteric fermentation, manure). EU methane also includes waste and energy fugitives — not captured here due to data constraints.
notes.N2O: Simplified specification due to absence of fertiliser intensity data at country level. AgriLand serves as agricultural intensification proxy.
notes.CO2_AFOLU: Land-use structural representation. ForestArea expected negative (sequestration). AgriLand expected positive (land conversion). IPCC AR6 WG3 acknowledges ±70% uncertainty in LULUCF estimates.
